profiles.name: Zahari Kechik
profiles.description: Zahari Kechik represents Jeli, Kelantan, in the Dewan Rakyat. An independent MP supporting the government under a confidence-and-supply agreement.
profiles.affiliation_note: An independent MP supporting the government under the reported confidence-and-supply agreement. No political-party membership is inferred; attendance at a PKR event is not treated as joining PKR.
